text:
elaine: Morning! Who microwaved the mystery curry in the kitchen? Smelled like a travel-sized spice bazaar. :nose: :grimacing:

matt: guilty. leftover curry from last night's dinner. will admit, it smelled glorious to me. :sweat_smile:

sophia: ramen confession too. real #desk-chef hours. pls don't judge my 2am noodle life. :ramen:

noah: PSA — please label your Tupperware. found an unmarked lasagna container. @elaine any idea? :thinking_face:

elaine: not mine! but I DID bring peppermint bark to the coffee station. free samples. 🍫🎄

matt: coming for that snack :raised_hands:

maya: also brought a box of mismatched mittens — free for anyone with cold fingers. winter survival station by the lounge. :mittens: :sparkles:

sophia: my left glove has gone rogue, so this is perfect.

ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen fridge cleanup tomorrow at 5pm. Unlabeled/old items will be composted. :recycle:

noah: Need a hot chocolate rec — family coming over tonight, want to impress without actual chef skill.

elaine: easy one: 2 cups milk, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch of salt. heat gently, whisk, top with marshmallows. pro tip: tiny splash of espresso or cinnamon for grown-up vibes.

matt: adult upgrade: add a shot of peppermint schnapps. instant office (and party) approval. :cocktail:

sophia: posted a quick printable recipe in #random-polls (link). I'll bring some paper copies to the coffee station later.

maya: tiny poll: ugly-holiday-mittens contest on Friday at 4pm by coffee station? winner gets peppermint bark. react :one: for yes, :two: for no

matt: :one:

noah: :one:

sophia: :one: (will craft a tragic knitted masterpiece)

elaine: :two: (I draw the line at competitive mittens)

maya: contest confirmed — bring your worst knit. bonus points for glitter yarn. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Pinned: Holiday mug exchange sign-up sheet (signup link). Please add your name by Thursday EOD.

matt: signed up! my mug has a tiny chip so it's basically vintage.

sophia: panic-level: what if my mug is just... beige? is beige allowed?

elaine: beige is a vibe. no mug shaming.

noah: closing notes: cocoa hour Friday 4pm, mittens contest right after. See you there — bring sweets or your worst knit. :hot_chocolate:
